baseline_models.focus_anchor: The verb of witnessing is joined directly to a passive designation of people who have been brought near.
baseline_models.mechanism: Direct presence and privileged nearness reinforce one another: access removes distance, and removed distance makes the encounter first-hand rather than reported.

activation_trace.role: Presence with direct seeing supplies the immediate mode of encounter.
Favored courtly access explains why this group can be present at the object.

changed_reading.after: Those admitted into privileged proximity encounter it directly, with nearness functioning as the condition of first-hand witness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same witnessing verb can denote informed testimony, while the plural subject is a favored inner circle.
baseline_models.mechanism: The group does more than look: knowledge is converted into declaration or certification by people whose admitted position gives their testimony standing.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge-bearing testimony supplies an attesting rather than merely optical act.
The privileged inner circle supplies institutional standing for the attestation.

changed_reading.before: A group happens to observe it.
changed_reading.after: An admitted circle knowingly attests it, making their proximity a credential as well as a location.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Witnessing can orient toward a visible sign of a state or quality, and the subject is defined by nearness.
baseline_models.mechanism: The object is not inert information but something whose condition becomes self-evident as a sign when encountered without distance.

activation_trace.role: A visible sign bearing evidence of state or quality makes witnessing an act of recognition.
The removal of distance makes the evidentiary sign directly legible.

changed_reading.after: At close range they recognize an object that itself bears a visible, state-revealing sign.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A supplied branch of the witnessing root locates witness in tongue or outward expression.
baseline_models.mechanism: Witness can pass from sight into articulate manifestation: what the close circle knows becomes expressible and publicly legible through them.

activation_trace.role: The tongue or visible expression supplies an articulate vehicle for witness.
Favored access identifies the circle through whom the witness may be voiced.

changed_reading.after: The admitted circle may also make the witnessed reality articulate, so presence can issue in authoritative expression.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening asymmetry of taking in full and giving short moves through just calibration into an efficacy-bearing written mark; informed witnesses now read as the agents who attest the exact account that defeats manipulated measure.

activation_trace.role: Testimony from knowledge turns inspection into evidentiary attestation.
Privileged access gives the attesting group standing at the account.
Completion without deficiency supplies the standard against which the account is settled.
The just scale supplies the calibrating norm behind exact testimony.
Deliberate deficiency in measure supplies the distortion the witnessed account exposes.
A written fixing that carries judgment makes the object consequential evidence.
The inscribed line in a register gives the evidence durable exact form.

structural_cues: The one-sided taking and giving sequence at 83:2-3 culminates in the marked record immediately before 83:21.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies full measure, just weighing, deficient measuring, an efficacy-bearing writing, and an inscribed register; I supply the arrow from those elements to adjudicative attestation. A live alternative is that the record registers the outcome without serving as a trial exhibit.

changed_reading.before: The close ones see a written object.
changed_reading.after: Authorized witnesses attest an exact evidentiary account whose fixed measure exposes and reverses manipulated deficiency.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same marked-record construction appears at a confined lower pole and an honored upper pole, but only the latter is followed by witnesses. The decisive contrast is therefore not data versus no data, but confinement and blocked access versus admitted presence and open attestation.

activation_trace.role: Direct presence marks the access granted at the upper record.
Privileged admission supplies the positive pole of the access contrast.
Confinement in a holding place supplies the closed lower pole.
The first inscribed register establishes the exact construction repeated above.
Prevention of arrival supplies the explicit denial of access.
Honor and elevated rank supply the open upper pole.
Entry into a register or company makes the upper record a site of admitted belonging.
The repeated inscription keeps the informational form constant while access changes.

structural_cues: 83:9 and 83:20 repeat the same two-word construction, while 83:21 follows only the upper instance.
The denied arrival of 83:15 is answered by the granted nearness of 83:21.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated inscriptions, confinement, denied arrival, upper honor, and privileged presence; I infer that the asymmetry is a topology of access and attestation. Alternatively, the witnesses may honor the upper realm without differentiating the records' custody.

changed_reading.before: The verse adds witnesses as another honorific detail.
changed_reading.after: The verse reveals an access regime: the upper record is openly attended by an admitted circle, in contrast to confinement and exclusion at the lower pole.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later recurrence of the same close group at a spring moves nearness from courtly admission into approach to a source. Drinking, including the supplied understanding branch, makes first-hand witnessing participatory: the witness knows by receiving from the source, not by standing outside it.

activation_trace.role: Immediate presence anchors the model in first-hand witness.
Removal of distance allows witness to become direct participation.
A flowing source supplies the origin from which direct reception occurs.
Drinking as understanding supplies the cross-domain move from reception to knowing.
The repeated favored group identifies privileged witness and privileged drinker as one role.
Movement toward water turns nearness into active approach to the source.

structural_cues: The same plural designation closes both 83:21 and 83:28, with witnessing first and source-drinking second.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies direct presence, a flowing source, a drinking-as-understanding branch, and the repeated group; I infer an experiential arrow from access to intake to knowing. The alternative is simple participant continuity with no epistemic relation between witnessing and drinking.

changed_reading.before: Privileged observers inspect something from nearby.
changed_reading.after: Their witness is source-near and participatory: they know first-hand by receiving from the very source to which their nearness grants access.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence expands evidence from a witnessed object into mutually facing observers and recognizable radiance on faces. Record and embodied condition form a corroborating circuit: what is attended in 83:21 later leaves a readable effect rather than remaining hidden writing.

activation_trace.role: A sign that discloses state or quality anchors the expansion from record to visible evidence.
Close range supplies the condition under which signs can be read directly.
Mutual facing makes the later scene relational rather than a one-way gaze.
Recognition from an effect or mark supplies the evidentiary reading of bodies.
Face-to-face encounter supplies the surface on which evidence is exchanged.
Visible radiance supplies the bodily sign that corroborates the witnessed account.
The repeated facing posture closes the later reversal with sustained visibility.

structural_cues: 83:21 is followed immediately by observers whose condition is recognizable on their faces, and 83:35 repeats the observing posture.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a state-bearing sign, mutual facing, recognition by a mark, and visible radiance; I infer that embodied effects corroborate the witnessed record. A live alternative is that record and radiant faces are sequential rewards with no evidentiary feedback between them.

changed_reading.before: Witness remains confined to inspection of a document.
changed_reading.after: Witness opens a circuit of corroboration in which the attended record and the later readable condition of faces disclose the same reality.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later speakers pronounce judgment on others, then are explicitly denied any commission as guardians. Against that failed standing, the close witnesses of 83:21 read as an authorized evidentiary circle: admission, not mere looking or speaking, distinguishes witness from intrusive surveillance.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge-bearing testimony supplies the valid evidentiary act.
Articulate expression distinguishes a qualified declaration from casual looking.
Favored access supplies the standing that the later judges lack.
The act of imposing a judgment on another supplies the rival, unauthorized verdict.
Messenger and message supply the notion of formal commission that is explicitly denied.
Guarding oversight supplies the office the mockers were not assigned.

structural_cues: The verdict in 83:32 is immediately followed by the denial of any guarding commission in 83:33.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies imposed judgment, denied commission, guarding oversight, informed testimony, and favored access; I infer that nearness marks legitimate standing. Alternatively, the close group's rank may be honorific without constituting an office.

changed_reading.before: Anyone who sees may count as a witness.
changed_reading.after: Only the admitted circle has standing to attest; the later mockers are exposed as speakers and watchers without jurisdiction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The marked record is followed by sealing, stamp-impression, and holding imagery. By material analogy, the close circle's witness can guarantee intact custody: their presence attests not only content but that the marked object has remained closed, held, and unaltered until disclosure.

activation_trace.role: Informed attestation supplies the validating act in a custody mechanism.
Restricted inner access identifies those able to attest intact custody.
A durable inscription supplies the object whose integrity matters.
A preventative seal supplies controlled access and protection from alteration.
The stamp and its impression supply a visible authentication mark.
Holding and retaining supply the continuity of custody.

structural_cues: The sequence runs from inscription to witness to a sealed object whose closure leaves an impression.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inscription, informed witnesses, a preventative seal, a stamped trace, and retention; I supply the chain-of-custody arrow across record and drink imagery. The live alternative is that sealing belongs only to reward imagery and does not qualify the record's witness.

changed_reading.before: The group confirms what the object says.
changed_reading.after: The admitted witnesses also authenticate the object's unbroken custody, attesting that its marked content reaches disclosure intact.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a rare material branch of the focus verb rather than its ordinary witnessing sense. It remains anchored by that supplied focus branch and is unusually reinforced by the later branch that explicitly links mixture with honey, plus sealed drink imagery. Render it only as a material resonance of intact sweetness, never as a replacement translation of the verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A focus branch associates the witnessing root with honey still held in its comb before pressing.

activation_trace.role: Honey retained in its comb supplies the image of sweetness intact within a matrix.
Restricted favored access identifies those admitted to the intact reserve.
A selected clear drink activates the valued liquid domain around the focus branch.
A secure seal reinforces preservation before access.
The supplied honey-as-mixture branch directly reactivates the focus root's comb image.
Literal drinking completes the material path from sealed reserve to reception.

changed_reading.before: The verse presents only an abstract act of witnessing.
changed_reading.after: Beneath that ordinary sense, the witnessed object resonates as sweetness kept intact in its matrix and reserved for those granted access.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant and must not be rendered as childbirth semantics for the verse. It remains worth carrying because both focus roots independently supply near-delivery or birth-trace branches, while context adds stirring, splitting-open, and birth-release images. Qualify it as an emergence metaphor in which witness marks passage from hidden potential into perceptible actuality.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The two focus roots coactivate a birth trace and a state of nearing delivery.

activation_trace.role: A trace accompanying birth supplies material evidence that something has emerged.
Nearing delivery supplies the threshold state immediately before manifestation.
Stirring what was still supplies the first motion from latency into emergence.
Wide splitting and issuing forth supply the opening through which the latent becomes manifest.
Birth-release supplies a later echo of completed emergence.

changed_reading.before: Witnessing is a static inspection of something already manifest.
changed_reading.after: As a contained image, witnessing marks the threshold event in which a latent reality is brought forth and becomes perceptibly evidenced.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because it lets temporal completion color a participial designation that more naturally denotes ranked persons, and one activator comes from a non-dominant split mapping. It remains anchored in a supplied temporal-nearness branch of the focus root and converges with closure and returning recompense. Render it as a secondary temporal overlay, not as displacement of privileged status.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The nearness root can carry a promised time drawing near and a thing approaching completion, while the witnessing root can close that process by testimony.

activation_trace.role: Testimony from knowledge supplies the act that closes and certifies the process.
Temporal nearness and approaching completion supply the terminal overlay.
The non-dominant mapped branch supplies final destination and return as a contextual echo.
Reaching the end and completing a seal supplies formal closure.
Recompense returning to its doer supplies the completed return certified by witness.

changed_reading.before: The brought-near are only a permanently ranked class.
changed_reading.after: As a secondary overlay, they are also the witnesses convened at closure, when the account reaches completion and action returns to its doer.

strongest_changes: Measurement and inscription turn witnessing into exact adjudicative attestation rather than passive seeing.
The repeated lower and upper records make privileged nearness an access regime, not merely an honorific.
The same group's later source-drinking recasts first-hand witness as participatory knowing.
The denial of a guarding commission to later judges distinguishes authorized witness from intrusive gaze and speech.
summary.what_was_special: The two focus roots support several coexisting mechanisms at once: direct presence, credentialed testimony, visible signs, and articulate witness. Context then produced unusually specific cross-domain activations, especially the focus root's comb-honey branch being reactivated by a later honey-mixture branch, and the two focus roots jointly carrying a birth-threshold image.
remaining_uncertainties: The pronoun's precise target may be the marked book, its containing height, or the disclosed reality carried by either.
Privileged rank and formal witness-office reinforce one another here but need not be identical.
The relation between the righteous and the brought-near remains compatible with overlap, subset, or adjacent groups.
The material honey, delivery, and temporal-closure readings are branch-grounded resonances, but their degree of semantic activation remains exploratory.
